raw.query:
WITH frontier AS (
  SELECT window_name, model, lead_s, readiness, all_feasible, worst_p99_ms
  FROM provenance.v_closedloop_frontier
  WHERE quantile = 'p50' AND rho = 15 AND window_name <> 'aggregate'
), readiness_totals AS (
  SELECT readiness, COUNT(*) AS cells, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE all_feasible) AS clears
  FROM frontier
  GROUP BY readiness
), window_breakdown AS (
  SELECT readiness, window_name, COUNT(*) AS cells,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE all_feasible) AS clears
  FROM frontier
  GROUP BY readiness, window_name
), calm_frontier AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT model) AS models,
         COUNT(DISTINCT lead_s) AS leads,
         MIN(worst_p99_ms) AS min_p99_ms,
         MAX(worst_p99_ms) AS max_p99_ms,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE all_feasible) AS clears
  FROM frontier
  WHERE window_name = 'steady24h'
), calm_infraction AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS current_rows, MIN(i.bound_ms) AS bound_ms,
         MIN(i.achieved_p99_ms) AS min_p99_ms,
         MAX(i.achieved_p99_ms) AS max_p99_ms,
         BOOL_AND(i.is_violation) AS all_violations
  FROM provenance.v_infraction i
  JOIN provenance.v_dim d ON d.run_id = i.run_id AND d.pool = i.pool
  WHERE i.is_current = true AND d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL
    AND d.experiment = 'ctmatrix' AND d.policy = 'forecast'
    AND d.window_name = 'steady24h' AND d.quantile = 'p50' AND d.rho = 15
    AND i.sla_metric = 'encoder_delay' AND i.bound_stat = 'p99'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('readiness', readiness, 'cells', cells, 'clears', clears) ORDER BY readiness) FROM readiness_totals) AS totals,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('readiness', readiness, 'window', window_name, 'cells', cells, 'clears', clears) ORDER BY readiness, window_name) FROM window_breakdown) AS per_window,
  (SELECT row_to_json(calm_frontier) FROM calm_frontier) AS calm_frontier,
  (SELECT row_to_json(calm_infraction) FROM calm_infraction) AS calm_infraction
raw.observed: At rho=15, strict readiness clears 23/60 cells and warm readiness clears 24/60. steady24h has 0 clears across 24 readiness-expanded rows covering 3 models and 4 leads, with p99 exactly 1073.139 ms throughout; the current, non-superseded v_infraction row has bound 1000 ms and is_violation=true.
raw.claimed: 23--24 of 60 cells; steady24h p99 1073 ms at every lead and model
raw.evidence: The strict/warm frontier totals are exactly 23/60 and 24/60, while current v_infraction confirms the steady24h encoder-delay p99 of 1073.139 ms violates the 1000 ms bound.
